# American Chamber of Commerce in Latvia

> > AmCham Latvia connects U.S. and Latvian business communities through advocacy, networking, and work groups focused on healthcare, digital transformation, and economic development.

The American Chamber of Commerce in Latvia (AmCham) serves as a bridge between American and Latvian businesses, facilitating dialogue on key policy areas including healthcare innovation, value-based healthcare (VBHC), and corporate social responsibility. The organization convenes industry work groups and supports member companies in navigating Latvia's business environment.

## Key Topics

- American Chamber of Commerce in Latvia
- Healthcare Work Group
- Value-Based Healthcare (VBHC)
- Value-Based Pricing (VBP)
- Digital health and precision medicine
- Preventive health and workplace wellness
- Healthcare financing models
- COVID-19 response initiatives
- Corporate social responsibility
- Latvia business environment
- Community support and charitable giving
- U.S.-Latvia business relations
